grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity before processing the bus pass application

grants.description: Verify you have reached State Pension age
grants.purpose: To confirm eligibility for the free bus pass based on State Pension age

grants.description: Confirm your current address to determine the issuing local authority
grants.purpose: To identify which local authority will issue your pass and where to send it

grants.description: Provide a photo for your bus pass card
grants.purpose: Your photo will appear on the physical bus pass card for identification purposes

grants.description: Share evidence of qualifying disability (if applying on disability grounds)
grants.purpose: To verify eligibility for disabled persons' bus pass if under State Pension age

revocation.mechanism: Contact your local authority or revoke through your GOV.UK account
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before the pass is issued

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot upload photos on your behalf without your explicit approval. Agent cannot change your registered address without your confirmation. Agent cannot appeal a rejection decision.
